title: sonerila robusta var. thwaitesii
intro: Sonerila robusta var. thwaitesii, commonly known as the Sri Lankan Sonerila, is a plant species within the Sonerila genus, native to Sri Lanka. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its multiple health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sonerila robusta var. thwaitesii include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
